payload.title: integration-line: the integrator is still called a position in prose
payload.body: Assay of integration-line at d9228821. The integrator role's anchor moved from 'integrator position' to 'integrator role' because position was a second sign for the same concept. Every identifier, path and projected surface of the integrator spells role (integratorRole, roles/integrator.ts, dimensions/role/integrator.ts, the agent description and archetype, the role value, the deliver skill). The prose around them still calls it a position: docs/role.md:108 ('The fifth position is the one the architect session had been performing itself', in the paragraph where the unit changed 'architect position' to 'architect role') and :143 ('this position was reached'); the comments in dimensions/role/integrator.ts:17,21,23, roles/integrator.ts:14,20,31 and agents/integrator.ts:7 ('facts about the POSITION'; the same comment says 'the integrate role'). The same residue runs through the other four roles' files and docs/role.md:64-65, which no unit of this plan owns, so it is a corpus-wide sweep rather than this unit's gap.
